definition: A form used to report sales and other dispositions of business property, including depreciable tangible property, real property, involuntary conversions, and recapture amounts under sections 179 and 280F(b)(2).

includes.text: Contains multiple parts organized by property type and holding period, with sections for depreciation recapture calculations
Includes detailed line items for reporting gains and losses from property dispositions organized by section 1231 treatment
Contains sections for reporting depreciation recapture on section 1245 and 1250 property
Includes a section for recapture of section 179 deductions and listed property depreciation

excludes.text: Does not report capital asset sales that are reported on a different form
Does not report depreciation and amortization deductions for property still in service
Does not report farm income and expenses in the same manner as farming operations

discriminators.text: Reports dispositions of business property with depreciation recapture calculations; the sibling reports only capital asset sales and exchanges without recapture provisions
Reports gains and losses from property dispositions and recapture amounts; the sibling reports depreciation deductions for property currently in use
Reports this document with multiple parts for different property types and holding periods; the sibling reports farm profit or loss from ongoing farming operations
discriminators.quote: Where To Make First Entry for Certain Items Reported on This Form
